extracted.intended_audience: CTSA Program institutions' RPPR preparers (PIs, grant administrators, research staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and supporting materials for preparing and submitting Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPRs) for NIH NCATS Clinical and Translational Science Awards (CTSA) Program grant mechanisms (UM1, UL1, KL2, TL1), plus related guidance for K12/T32 training awards and human subjects validation errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission using RPPR format (NOT-OD-15-014 requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH Guide notice NOT-OD-15-014 requires that all grant progress reports for the CTSA Program grant mechanisms be submitted electronically using the Research Performance Progress Report (RPPR) format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please visit the NIH RPPR page for an overview and technical assistance for preparing and submitting reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read the NCATS 2026 Supporting Instructions for CTSA RPPRs
rubrics_metrics.description: Read RPPR guidance for CTSA Program institutions: 2026 Supporting Instructions for CTSA Program RPPRs – UM1 (PDF - 446KB) – UPDATED JANUARY 2026; 2026 Supporting Instructions for Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPRs) for the Clinical and Translational Science Awards (CTSA) Program UL1, KL2 and TL1 Awards (PDF - 535KB) – UPDATED FEBRUARY 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download and read the appropriate PDF for your mechanism (UM1 or UL1/KL2/TL1) to follow NCATS-specific supporting instructions and any appended materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open PDFs in a PDF application to access appendices
rubrics_metrics.description: Download the PDF files below and open them in your computer’s PDF application (e.g., Acrobat Reader) in order to access the appendices attached to the PDF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some appendices are embedded in the PDFs and will only be accessible when opened in a full PDF reader application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow NIH instructions in Section 7.4 for K12 and T32 mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow the NIH instructions in Section 7.4 for the K12 and T32 grant mechanisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you would like to use the Appendix 3: Training Progress Report template, you can download it (Word - 45KB). Use of the template is not required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correcting human subjects submission validation errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for Correcting Human Subjects Submission Validation Errors (PDF - 808KB).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult this document for instructions on resolving validation errors related to human subjects submissions that affect RPPR/related reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use NIH RPPR resources for technical assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Refer to the NIH RPPR page for an overview and technical assistance for preparing and submitting reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIH-provided RPPR resources should be used as the primary technical reference for RPPR format, field definitions, and electronic submission procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact NCATS CTSA RPPR support / FAQs
rubrics_metrics.description: RPPR FAQs — Email us your questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided CTSA RPPR contact and FAQs for program-specific questions not answered by the NIH RPPR page or the supporting instruction PDFs.
